路由(skills 席代分诊):`domain:engine` · `priority:p2` —— 四处 JSDoc 教一个已退役的列写行为(零非注释出现,反向对照 44 在案;pin 测试已强制新行为),且坐在插件选项接口的门面文档上 —— 正是决定「要不要写 environment_id」的读者读的位置。修向 = 订正散文(⛔ 不删仍活跃的 environmentId 选项,卡已划界);与 #13433(sys_activity 幽灵列)同族分办。

## 分诊判级 · `finding` → **`pm:queue`** · `documentation` · **p2** · `domain:engine`

**域**:落点 `packages/objectql` 与 `packages/metadata-protocol`,两者均在 engine 车道 ⇒ `domain:engine`。

### 判据

四处 JSDoc 仍在教「`saveMetaItem` 给新 `sys_metadata` 行盖 `environment_id`、`loadMetaFromDb` 按该列过滤」,而它们所在的代码**非注释处对 `environment_id` 零命中**。⇒ 散文教的是一个**已经不存在的机制**。

### ⚠️ 方向:这条比普通文档漂移更该修一点

一个读到 `:3976-3988` 那句「every saveMetaItem insert/update and loadMetaFromDb query is filtered by `environment_id = environmentId`」的作者,会**据此相信存在一层环境隔离**。而它不存在。

⇒ 危险不是「注释过时」,是**它描述的是一道隔离屏障**。⛔ 升级闸:若发现任何现行设计/评审**援引过**这四处散文来论证隔离性 ⇒ 那就不再只是文档问题,回分诊重判。

⛔ 仍判 p2:今天的运行时行为不受注释影响,且 `organization_id` 才是现行的隔离键。

### ⭐ 家族说明(本轮判的三张同源)

| 卡 | 面 | 本轮判 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **#13434**(本卡) | 4 处 JSDoc 说 stamp/filter,代码零命中 | `documentation`·p2·`domain:engine` |
| **#13433** | `sys_activity` 声明 `environment_id` 为活列且建索引,无写入方 | `bug`·p2·`domain:services` |
| **#13416** | `createFieldPresenceProbe` 的 docstring 说 `organization_id` 只在多租户模式注入,实为无条件 | `documentation`·p2·`domain:engine` |

三张都是**同一次持久层普查**(#13368 / PR #13431)掉出来的残余,根因相同:**列的语义改了,散文没跟上。**

⭐ **而根那一条已经修好了**:本席本轮实测 `origin/main`,AGENTS.md 第 8 行现读作 `DB column environment_id [control-plane tables; on the metadata tables since deprecated in favour of or…]`,由 PR #13431(`370524dd`,08-30 13:36Z)改的,**一行**。⇒ 这三张是那次修正**没覆盖到的下游站点**,不是重复。

⇒ 本卡与 #13416 可**一次交付**(都是 engine 车道的散文);#13433 ⛔ 单独走(它动代码与索引)。

## CLAIMED + dispatch order — #13434

- **Session:** `session_01F3jdziLbAPGeceVNmSox5L`
- **Branch:** `claude/issue-13434-environment-id-stale-jsdoc`
- **Worktree:** `../objectstack-13434-stale-jsdoc`, off `origin/main` (`eaba72e48c`)
- **Labels:** `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`
- **Clause ②: NO.** Path limb NO (nothing under `packages/spec/src/**`); content limb NO (comment-only prose; no contract accept/reject behaviour moves and no public surface widens). Declare your own reading from the **actual diff**; you may overrule **upward**, never downward.

---

## Zone 1 — 裁决 (binding)

No maintainer ruling. What binds is **triage's routing**, quoted verbatim from `5472924179` and `5472927836`:

> 修向 = 订正散文(⛔ 不删仍活跃的 environmentId 选项,卡已划界)

> ⛔ 升级闸:若发现任何现行设计/评审**援引过**这四处散文来论证隔离性 ⇒ 那就不再只是文档问题,回分诊重判。

- **1.1 — Correct the prose. ⛔ Do not touch behaviour.** The card's own boundary: the `environmentId` **option is very much alive** (44+ non-comment `environmentId` sites in `protocol.ts` — the overlay-whitelist gate, the local metadata-storage provisioning decision, and more). ⛔ **A fix that deletes the option would be wrong.** Only the *column stamp/filter* job these four comments describe is gone.
- **1.2 — The escalation gate is live and is yours to run.** If you find any current design or review that **cited these four passages to argue isolation holds**, this stops being a docs card. **STOP and report** — triage re-grades, ⛔ not you and ⛔ not me.
- **1.3 — ⛔ #13416 is NOT yours.** Triage suggested delivering it with this card, but its labels still read `finding` with **no `pm:queue`** — it has not been routed. ⛔ Do not touch `packages/metadata-core/src/record-organization.ts`. If it is queued later it is a separate PR.
- **1.4 — ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/`.** Your input to release notes is the changeset.

---

## Zone 2 — PM 机制假设 (measure these; ⭐ falsification is a reportable success)

**A2.1 — ⭐⭐ THE ONE MOST LIKELY TO BITE. "The card's four line numbers still point at the right text."** ⛔ Almost certainly false. The card measured on `origin/main` at **`c813e7ac7`**; `main` is now **`eaba72e48c`**, many merges later, and **two of the four sites are in `protocol.ts` at `:3976-3988` and `:19488-19490`** — deep in a file this lane has been changing.

⇒ **Re-locate all four by NEEDLE (the literal prose), never by line number.** This lane has been bitten by line-number rot twice tonight already: #13635's doc census anchors 15 sites in `engine.ts` by line and every one shifted under a `+43/-8` edit. Treat the card's coordinates as a hint and the quoted sentences as the identifier.

**A2.2 — "The zero is real."** The card claims zero non-comment `environment_id` occurrences in the three files, and — correctly — reverse-checks it against `organization_id` answering **44** in `protocol.ts` with the same filter. ⭐ **Re-run both halves yourself**, including the positive control. A grep that has silently stopped matching returns the same zero as a true absence. The card's own re-check block gives the commands.

**A2.3 — "All four sites want the same correction."** My assumption; the card lists four passages with different wording and different jobs (two plugin-options docstrings, one long protocol narrative at `:3976-3988`, one short scope-filter line at `:19488-19490`). Falsifiable: one of them may describe something that is still partly true and need a narrower edit than the others.

**A2.4 — "Prose-only, so no test moves."** Falsifiable: `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts:403-425` already pins the new behaviour (create carries `organization_id`, **not** `environment_id`; no `findOne` where-clause has it). If any doc-authoring or anchor gate reads these comments, an edit could move a gate. ⛔ Measure rather than assume — see the census lesson above.

---

## Zone 3 — PM 建议路线 (advisory)

- The replacement prose should say what is true **now** and, where useful, that the column job was retired — a bare deletion loses the signal for the next reader who wonders whether environment scoping ever existed.
- Corroborating sources already in-tree, worth matching wording against: `database-loader.ts:75-85` (`@deprecated`, *"accepted for back-compat but ignored"*) and `sys-metadata.object.ts:138-148` (*"no longer written by saveMetaItem and not consulted by overlay reads"*).
- ⚠️ **Before your first edit, verify no other open PR claims `packages/metadata-protocol/src/**`.** The repo gate `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path` will catch a collision at PR time, but it will have cost you the whole implementation by then. This lane's own open PRs (#13630 `packages/formula`, #13635 `packages/objectql`) do not collide; other lanes are unmeasured.

---

## STOP conditions

1. **The escalation gate fires** (Zone 1.2) — any design or review cites these passages as evidence of isolation.
2. **The zero does not reproduce** with a firing positive control — then the card's premise is wrong and the fix may be the opposite direction.
3. **Any correction would require a behaviour change**, i.e. a site where the prose is right and the code is wrong.
4. **An open PR already claims `packages/metadata-protocol/src/**`.**

---

## ⚠️ Known-red on arrival — ⛔ NOT yours to fix

`Test Core (6/6)` fails on **every** PR right now via **#13645**: `packages/core/src/security/authz-store-unavailable.test.ts` walks and reads all of `packages/` twice under a 5000 ms budget, and `main` is already over the line with no diff at all. A fix is separately dispatched. Expect that red, ⛔ do not repair it here, and ⛔ do not read it as a signal about your own change.

## Verification expected

The re-located needles (quote what you found and where), both halves of the A2.2 control, the affected packages' suites, and a changeset. ⛔ Report anything you could not measure as **NOT MEASURED**, never as a pass. ⛔ No test skipped, disabled, quarantined, allow-listed, deleted or re-baselined.

## ⚠️ One figure in this card's body does not reproduce — recording it before it gets re-cited

PR #13665 (head `121f2c332c`) implements this card. In the course of it the seat re-measured every number here, and one did not hold.

**The card states**, under "What is NOT claimed":

> ⛔ **Not claimed that the `environmentId` option is dead.** It is very much alive in `protocol.ts` (**44+ non-comment `environmentId` sites**: the overlay-whitelist gate, the local metadata-storage provisioning decision, and more).

**Measured:** `environmentId` has **12** non-comment sites in `protocol.ts` — **27** across the three files (`protocol.ts` 12, `metadata-protocol/src/plugin.ts` 9, `objectql/src/plugin.ts` 6). Not 44.

⭐ **The likely origin, and why it is worth naming:** **44 is this card's own positive-control figure** — the count of `organization_id` non-comment occurrences in `protocol.ts`, quoted two paragraphs earlier under "The column count, comment-stripped". The control's number appears to have been carried across onto a different measurement.

### ⛔ What this does NOT change

- **The claim's DIRECTION holds completely.** The `environmentId` option is alive and deleting it would be wrong. 12 live sites is still emphatically alive, and the card's warning was honoured: the option is untouched, with non-comment counts **byte-identical before and after** (12 / 9 / 6).
- **The card's load-bearing measurement is unaffected.** The `environment_id` **column** count is **0** non-comment in all three files, re-run with the positive control firing at 44 — and strengthened beyond the card: the complete raw set is only 12 occurrences across the three files, and all 12 were classified **by hand** as sitting inside comments, so no code occurrence exists for a regex to have missed.
- Nothing about the fix moves.

Recorded because a wrong number in a card body outlives the card — this repo has already paid for that once, in #13548 / #13638, where a census's figures survived only because a changeset author happened to quote them.

### Two other corrections to this card, from the same run

**The four sites were seven.** Re-running this card's own census surfaced three more passages carrying the identical false claim, all in files the PR already touches: `protocol.ts:4492`, `protocol.ts:5090` (on `getProjectId` — "route a read through the protocol's `environment_id`-filtered lookup"; no such lookup exists), and `objectql/src/plugin.ts:76` — the last of which carries **no literal `environment_id`** and so was invisible to a grep-anchored census.

**Two of the four line anchors had rotted**, by **+125** and **+150** lines between `c813e7ac7` and `eaba72e48c`. Every site was re-found by its quoted prose. A line-anchored edit would have landed on unrelated code.

The escalation gate armed by triage (⛔ 若发现任何现行设计/评审援引过这四处散文来论证隔离性) was run against the distinctive phrases repo-wide and returned **zero hits** — it did **not** fire, so this stays a docs card.
